author: legosean10
body:
I saw that someone had made a new avicus promo video, so I decided I'd make a post about the one I made to see if anyone still likes it.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zW7J-p0LuXA

I'm thinking of getting back into video editing and all, so maybe some feedback?
-Sean
